errors.text_span: Линейната диаграма
errors.evidence: The description identifies the chart as a line chart ("линейна диаграма"), but it is a vertical bar chart.

errors.text_span: подредени в произволен ред
errors.evidence: The categories are not arranged in a random order. They are mostly in descending order of GPU memory usage, with the exception of the final category, "Ours".

errors.text_span: достигайки максимална стойност от 60 GB
errors.evidence: The y-axis scale shows 60 GB as a tick mark, but it is not the maximum value of the data. The tallest bar, "Full FT", extends well beyond this mark to approximately 75 GB.

errors.text_span: Най-високата стълба, съответстваща на Full FT, е с височина около 60 GB
errors.evidence: The value for the "Full FT" bar is approximately 75 GB, not 60 GB.

errors.text_span: а най-ниската стълба, съответстваща на Ours
errors.evidence: The lowest bar in the chart is "QLoRA" (approximately 13 GB), not "Ours" (approximately 22 GB).

errors.text_span: Под стълбите за Full FT и MTL-FT има други стълби
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the other bars are located 'under' the first two bars. All bars are arranged next to each other along the horizontal axis.

errors.text_span: подредени от най-ниската до най-високата
errors.evidence: The description claims the last four bars (TAG, LoRA, QLoRA, Ours) are arranged from lowest to highest. This is incorrect; their values are approximately 22, 22, 13, and 22 GB, which is not an ascending order.

The description fails to mention that the "Ours" bar is visually highlighted with a different color (green) compared to the other bars (orange), and that its label is bolded, which are important visual distinctions.

errors.text_span: Раззултата на оста се нарича "GPU Memory (GB)".
errors.evidence: The word "Раззултата" is not a standard or clear Bulgarian word in this context, making the sentence grammatically awkward and difficult to understand. It seems to be a mistranslation or typo for "Етикетът" (The label).

errors.text_span: ordered alphabetically from left to right
errors.evidence: The categories on the horizontal axis (Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA, Ours) are not ordered alphabetically.

errors.text_span: ranging from 0 to 65
errors.evidence: The tallest bar, 'Full FT', reaches a value of approximately 75, so the y-axis range extends beyond 65.

errors.text_span: reaches approximately 60 GB
errors.evidence: The bar for 'Full FT' clearly extends past the 60 GB grid line to a value of approximately 75 GB.

errors.text_span: “LoRA” at approximately 15 GB
errors.evidence: The bar for 'LoRA' reaches a value of approximately 22 GB, not 15 GB.

errors.text_span: “QLoRA” at approximately 30 GB
errors.evidence: The bar for 'QLoRA' is the shortest, at a value of approximately 12 GB, not 30 GB.

errors.text_span: All bars are colored differently—Full FT is orange, MTL-FT is yellow, TAG is green, LoRA is blue, QLoRA is dark orange, and Ours is light green
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates multiple colors. In the figure, the first five bars (Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA) are all the same orange color, and only the last bar ('Ours') is a different color (green).

errors.text_span: no bars are visually emphasized beyond their height
errors.evidence: The 'Ours' bar is visually emphasized with a distinct green color, differentiating it from the other five bars which are orange.

errors.text_span: Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, TAG, LoRA, LoRA und Ours
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly lists the categories on the x-axis. It repeats 'TAG' and 'LoRA' and completely omits the category 'QLoRA'. The correct list of categories is 'Full FT', 'MTL-FT', 'TAG', 'LoRA', 'QLoRA', and 'Ours'.

errors.text_span: erreicht eine Höhe von etwa 60 GB
errors.evidence: The bar for 'Full FT' clearly extends beyond the 60 GB line, reaching a value of approximately 75 GB, not 60 GB.

errors.text_span: der niedrigste Balken, der „LoRA“ darstellt
errors.evidence: The lowest bar in the chart corresponds to 'QLoRA' (approx. 12 GB), not 'LoRA' (approx. 22 GB).

errors.text_span: einen Wert von etwa 30 GB erreicht
errors.evidence: The bar for 'TAG' reaches a value of approximately 22 GB, not 30 GB.

errors.text_span: mit Höhen von etwa 15 GB bzw. 15 GB
errors.evidence: The description states that 'LoRA' and 'Ours' have heights of about 15 GB. In the chart, both bars reach a height of approximately 22 GB.

errors.text_span: Alle Balken sind in absteigender Reihenfolge sortiert
errors.evidence: The bars are not in strict descending order. For example, the bar for 'Ours' (approx. 22 GB) is taller than the bar for 'QLoRA' (approx. 12 GB), which precedes it in the chart.

The description fails to mention the colors of the bars. Specifically, it does not state that the bar for 'Ours' is green while all other bars are orange, which is a key visual distinction used for emphasis.
The description omits the title of the chart, which is 'QLoRA'.
The description does not specify the tick interval for the y-axis, which is 20 GB (ticks at 0, 20, 40, 60).
